# Single-cell analysis - Myeloid classification

Here, we will perform the third single cell analysis steps, including myeloid phenotyping.

## Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")
sce
```

## Filter sce for myeloid cells

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
#based on immune MC categories
sce <- sce[,sce$immune_metacluster %in% c("Myeloid","Neutrophil")]
sce
```

# 1. Clustering

## Define markers for clustering

```{r immune_markers, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# We will again use predefined markers 
rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","TMEM173","CD303","CD163","IDO1","DCLAMP","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","CD274","Arginase","CD33","VISTA","CD209", "CD206","CD15")

#Alternatively:
rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_1 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","CD303","CD163","IDO1","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","CD274","Arginase","CD33","VISTA","CD209", "CD206","CD15") #kick out DC_LAMP, TMEM173

rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_2 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","CD303","CD163","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","Arginase","CD33","CD209", "CD206","CD15", "DC_LAMP") #kick out IDO1, CD274, VISTA, TMEM173
```

## Run clustering

Next, we will run Rphenoannoy (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm) clustering with different resolution parameters. 

```{r cluster, message=FALSE}
library(Rphenoannoy)
set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster,])

#k=30
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 30)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_30 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_30)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=50
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 50)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_50 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_50)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=70

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_70 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_70)

gc()

#k=90

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=110

sce$my_cluster_110 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_110)
```

### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r}
#Pairwise rand index 
#Agreement between two clustering approaches - ARI > 0.5 = "good" similarity
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_30,sce$my_cluster_50, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_50,sce$my_cluster_70, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_70,sce$my_cluster_90, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_90,sce$my_cluster_110, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_110,sce$my_cluster_130, mode = "index")
```

```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_[:digit:]")]
my_clusters <- my_clusters[!str_detect(my_clusters, "_1_")]
my_clusters <- my_clusters[!str_detect(my_clusters, "_2_")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,3]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster")
}

my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_1_[:digit:]")]

df_1 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster_1")
}

my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_2_[:digit:]")]

df_2 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster_2")
}

df_out <- rbind(df, df_1, df_2)


p1 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")


p3 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  
p1+p2+p3 
```

### Visualization 

```{r}
# By cluster 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$my_cluster_2_110, #select cluster of interest
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_2)

other_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$my_cluster_110,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$use_channel)

Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")), col = viridis(100), clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  #Heatmap(t(assay(other_mean_sce, "exprs")), col = viridis(100))+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))))+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))
```

#### Violin Expression 

```{r}
# Violin Plot - plotExpression
# M2-like macrophages gain expression of exhaustion markers
set.seed(22)
cur_cells <- sce[, sce$my_cluster_110 %in% c("9","10","14")]$ObjectNumber

plotExpression(sce[,cur_cells], 
               features = c("IDO1","CD274"),
               x = "pT_combined", 
               exprs_values = "exprs", 
               colour_by = "pT_combined") +
    theme(axis.text.x =  element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ABCFE5","#08306B"))

plotExpression(sce[,cur_cells], 
               features = c("IDO1","CD274"),
               x = "ISUP_combined", 
               exprs_values = "exprs", 
               colour_by = "ISUP_combined") +
    theme(axis.text.x =  element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FC9F81","#67000D"))

plotExpression(sce[,cur_cells], 
               features = c("IDO1","CD274"),
               x = "necrose", 
               exprs_values = "exprs", 
               colour_by = "necrose") +
    theme(axis.text.x =  element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey","#3F007D"))

plotExpression(sce, 
               features = c("IDO1","CD274","HLADR"),
               x = "pT_combined", 
               exprs_values = "exprs", 
               colour_by = "pT_combined") +
    theme(axis.text.x =  element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ABCFE5","#08306B"))
```


### cytoviewer visualization

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds")
```

```{r}
# Select images of interest
set.seed(22)
cur_sample <- sample(unique(sce$sample_id), 30)

cur_sample <- (colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, my_cluster_110) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% filter(my_cluster_110 == "14") %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(sample_id))[1:10]

cur_images <- images[mcols(images)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_masks <- masks[mcols(masks)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
```


```{r}
library(cytoviewer)
cytoviewer(image = cur_images, mask = cur_masks, object = cur_sce, img_id = "sample_id", cell_id = "ObjectNumber")
```


# 2. Myeloid metacluster

### Rich heatmap 

Heatmap of clusters

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
sce$my_cluster_selected <- sce$my_cluster_110
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$my_cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over my_cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, my_cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-my_cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(my_cluster_selected = spatial$my_cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Metadata features

#Number of cells per my_cluster_selected 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(my_cluster_selected, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 1 cell)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_selected,PID) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>0) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

# Proportion of ISUP grade per cluster
ISUP <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_selected,ISUP) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP <- ISUP %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP <- ISUP %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = my_cluster_selected,names_from = ISUP,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_selected,pT_simple) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = my_cluster_selected,names_from = pT_simple,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

# Proportion of necrose per cluster
necrose <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_selected,necrose) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
necrose <- necrose %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
necrose <- necrose %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = my_cluster_selected,names_from = necrose,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP = anno_barplot(ISUP, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP)),
                            pT = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_simple)),
                            necrose = anno_barplot(necrose, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose)),

                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Define broader categories

library(clValid)

#Internal measures
set.seed(22)
testCL<- clValid(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs")),nClust = 4:10,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans","pam"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)

#Stability measures
```

```{r ana_cat}
h_draw <- draw(h)
row_order_ht <- row_order(h_draw)

anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(my_cluster_selected, ncells)

anno$myeloid_metacluster <- NA
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_ht))%do%{

anno$myeloid_metacluster[anno$myeloid_metacluster == "2"] <- "M2_like"
```

## Loop over categories 

### Myeloid cluster 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$my_cluster_110), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x == "necrose"){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```


```{r}
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$my_cluster_110), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$ISUP_combined <- relevel(x=factor(meta$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$ISUP_combined),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$ISUP_combined)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ISUP_combined, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined))%v%
  columnAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$my_cluster_110), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that pT 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$pT_combined <- relevel(x=factor(meta$pT_combined), ref = "1/2")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$pT_combined),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$pT_combined)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~pT_combined, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$pT_combined))%v%
  columnAnnotation(pT_combined = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$pT_combined)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.05")+
  ggtitle("pT_stage (1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
    geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (pT: 1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change (best?)
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (pT: 1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

# 5. Survival analysis 

## Multivariate cox models

## Cluster 

### Continious 

```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_my_cluster_110 <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_110,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_my_cluster_110 <- PID_my_cluster_110 %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_my_cluster_110 %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "my_cluster_110",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
colnames(PID_metagroups) <- paste0("MY_",colnames(PID_metagroups))

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -gender, -age, -ISUP, -pT, -MY_1) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ gender + age + ISUP + pT +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ MY_1"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

### Mean / Median 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_my_cluster_110 <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_110,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_my_cluster_110 <- PID_my_cluster_110 %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_my_cluster_110 %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "my_cluster_110",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("MY", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 

Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
Cox_df_mean$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -gender, -age, -ISUP, -pT, -MY2) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ gender + age + ISUP + pT +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ MY2"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

### GMM

```{r}
PID_my_cluster_110 <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_110,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_my_cluster_110 <- PID_my_cluster_110 %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("MY", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (GMM division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_GMM <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
GMM_Cox <- Mclust(Cox_df[,i], G = 2)
as.character(GMM_Cox$classification)
}

colnames(Cox_df_GMM) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_GMM) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_GMM <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_GMM,stringsAsFactors=TRUE)

Cox_df_GMM$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -gender, -age, -ISUP, -pT, -MY1) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ gender + age + ISUP + pT +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ MY1"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_GMM)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_GMM <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_GMM <- ggplot(plot_df_GMM, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_GMM")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_GMM
```

```{r}
}

colnames(Cox_df_GMM) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_GMM) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_GMM <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_GMM,stringsAsFactors=TRUE)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_GMM$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_GMM$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]

Cox_df_GMM$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])
Cox_df_GMM$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_GMM$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])
Cox_df_GMM$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -gender, -age, -ISUP, -pT, -MY_Other) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ gender + age + ISUP + pT +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ MY_Other"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_GMM)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_GMM <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_GMM <- ggplot(plot_df_GMM, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_GMM")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_GMM
```

# 6. Supervised analysis 

## HLADR GMM on myeloid cells 

```{r}
set.seed(22)
# HLADR
GMM_HLADR <- Mclust(assay(sce, "exprs")["HLADR",], G = 2)


GMM_df <- data.frame(class_HLA = ifelse(GMM_HLADR$classification == 2 & GMM_HLADR$uncertainty < 0.001, 
                                        "HLADR+",
                                        "HLADR-"), 
                     HLADR_exprs = assay(sce, "exprs")["HLADR",],
                     uncertainty = GMM_HLADR$uncertainty)

#Visualize GMM
ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = HLADR_exprs, fill = class_HLA))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = class_HLA))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

# Add HLA group 
sce$my_HLADR_GMM <- GMM_df$class_HLA[match(colnames(sce), rownames(GMM_df))]

n_cat <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(my_HLADR_GMM) %>% count()
n_cat <- n_cat %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% mutate(fra = (n/sum)*100)
```

```{r}
set.seed(22)

## Define patient groups 
plot_score_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID,my_HLADR_GMM) %>% count() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n))

ggplot(plot_score_PID, aes(x=PID, y=fra, fill = my_HLADR_GMM))+
  geom_tile(position = "fill")

plot_heat_PID <- plot_score_PID %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, values_from = fra, names_from = my_HLADR_GMM) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
plot_heat_PID[is.na(plot_heat_PID)] <- 0

testCL<- clValid(plot_heat_PID,nClust = 2:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)

dev.off()

h <- Heatmap(plot_heat_PID,
             name = "Proportion",
             col = viridis(100), 
             #row_km = 3, 
             #row_km_repeats = 100,
             row_split=3,
             show_row_names = FALSE)

h <- draw(h)

row_order_h <- row_order(h)

anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID) %>% unique()
anno$my_HLADR_group <- NA

for(i in seq_along(row_order_h)){
anno$my_HLADR_group <- as.factor(ifelse(anno$PID %in% rownames(plot_heat_PID)[row_order_h[[i]]], i, anno$my_HLADR_group))
}

sce$my_HLADR_group <- anno$my_HLADR_group[match(sce$PID, anno$PID)]
```


```{r}
cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, my_HLADR_group, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique() #%>% filter(my_HLADR_group %in% c("1","2"))

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ my_HLADR_group, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
```

```{r}
set.seed(22)
```

```{r}
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)

dev.off()

h <- Heatmap(plot_heat_PID,
             name = "Proportion",
             col = viridis(100), 
             row_km = 2, 
             row_km_repeats = 100,
             #row_split=2,

h <- draw(h)

anno <- colData(sce_M2) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID) %>% unique()
anno$my_CD274_group <- NA

for(i in seq_along(row_order_h)){
anno$my_CD274_group <- as.factor(ifelse(anno$PID %in% rownames(plot_heat_PID)[row_order_h[[i]]], i, anno$my_CD274_group))
}

sce_M2$my_CD274_group <- anno$my_CD274_group[match(sce_M2$PID, anno$PID)]
```
